studies.notes: Checked the saved arXiv v1 PDF dated 4 April 2026, the version used by the extraction file. Read the complete markdown conversion, including Appendices A-C, checked cited PDF pages with pymupdf, and searched all PDF pages for participant counts and flow statements. No separate supplement is named in the extraction sources. The main extracted outcomes are diversity of final participant stories, reported in Table 5 (PDF p. 28). The n_randomized fields transcribe the printed recruitment counts under this brief's randomized-or-enrolled definition; they do not establish a complete count of everyone randomized before exclusions. The paper does not reconcile recruitment and demographic counts with the exclusions, describe replacement recruitment, or explicitly print a final post-exclusion participant denominator for the main outcomes. Therefore total and per-arm n_analyzed remain null. No count is calculated by subtracting exclusions or adding subgroup counts. The adoption groups and repeated-draft subset are separate exploratory subsets, not substitutes for the main denominator. Out-of-range submissions were retained in the final analysis (PDF p. 20, Appendix A.1.4); no submission count is treated as a people count. Quotes normalize whitespace and the PDF font-mapping artifact that extracts equals signs as U+201C; the printed equals sign was visually checked in the Table 4 headings. PDF and printed page numbers coincide.
